crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.
How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
Yahweh, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?
They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on…
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.
Why should you be like a scared man, as a mighty man who can’t save? Yet you, Yahweh, are in the middle of us, and we…
Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.

translations.web: Yahweh, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?
translations.bsb: How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?
translations.kjv: O LORD, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
translations.asv: O Jehovah, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear? I cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save.
